name: Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus
effectText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Levia-Dragon - Daedalus". You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the GY, except this card.
